messages:
sam: heads-up i'm opening a small docs PR to clarify quota grace windows and update the dashboard panel that shows quota burn by tier. will also add a short SDKv4 curl example for the X-Quota-Tier header so it's obvious.

rachel: nice. can you include a line about the grace window semantics? folks keep asking whether requests during grace count against daily quotas.

sam: yes — i'll add: "Grace window applies only to surface-level throttles; requests accepted in the grace window are billed and will decrement the daily allowance."

devon: also add a note about how quotas interact with burst credits: burst credits are used first, then daily allowance decremented. i've seen customer confusion there.

sam: good call. i'll add a tiny diagram-like example: 
`Day allowance=1000, burst=200. if you use 250 in one hour -> burst 200 used, allowance -50.`

tia: for the dashboard change, please switch the panel aggregation from `sum(billing.quota_consumed)` to `sum by (tier) (rate(billing.quota_consumed[5m]))` so the hover shows per-minute burn rate instead of cumulative. that's more actionable.

sam: done in branch: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/5981 — updated panel and added migration note under "Quota dashboards".

ops-bot: lint and linkcheck running on PR #5981.

rachel: can you paste the new SDKv4 curl snippet here so i can sanity-check the header formatting?

sam: snippet added: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" -H "X-Quota-Tier: gold" \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate\" -d '{"model":"open-7b","input":"..."}'`

devon: prefer `X-Quota-Tier: gold` vs `X-Usage-Tier` for the quota docs, makes it explicit. we should keep naming consistent across quota pages.

sam: agreed. i kept `X-Quota-Tier` in quota docs and `X-Usage-Tier` in pricing/usage docs. added a cross-ref note.

tia: nits: 1) add the exact grafana panel UID in the migration note, 2) mention timezone for daily reset (UTC).

sam: added both: panel UID `G-qr7b2` and reset time `00:00 UTC`. also pushed a short changelog entry.

ops-bot: linkcheck: one internal anchor moved; auto-updated. all checks passed at 3290011260.

rachel: thanks — i'll add a follow-up ticket to the docs tracker to add a short FAQ entry about quota/burst examples.

sam: perfect, thanks everyone. closing thread.
